children: The Indonesian rupiah is likely to weaken following its recent gains, HSBC Global FX Research analysts say in a report. Subdued portfolio inflows and a sharp decline in foreign-exchange reserves are weighing on the rupiah, it says. The Indonesian central bank has said it will pivot from using high yields to providing foreign-exchange hedging incentives for attracting inflows. "In our view, this strategy may be tested later if the external backdrop deteriorates," HSBC says. The dollar is 0.2% lower at 17600 rupiah. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
